title: Austin's Closed-Door City Manager Interviews
summary:
*   Austin leaders held a special meeting to address key city administration.
*   The primary agenda item was interviewing candidates for the crucial City Manager position.
*   These candidate interviews were conducted in a closed, executive session, away from public view.
*   No public policy decisions or open session votes were recorded during this meeting.
